raw_segments.text: Lord, receive me with all my lawlessness, and do not condemn me.
Let me pass by thy judgment.
Do not condemn me, for I have condemned myself.
Do not condemn me, for I love thee, O Lord.
I am a wretch, but I love thee.
If thou sendest me to hell, I shall love thee there, and from there I shall cry out that
I love thee for ever and ever.
But let me love to the end, here and now for just five hours, till the first light of thy
day, for I love the queen of my soul.
I love her, and I cannot help loving her.
I shall fall before her and say, You are right to pass on and leave me.
